cookies.title: We use cookies
cookies.body: We use essential cookies for sign-in and ordering, plus optional analytics to improve the product. See our <link>privacy policy</link>.

update.ready: A new version of the app is ready

install.title: Install {name}
install.iosHint: Tap in Safari, then Add to Home Screen for one-tap reordering.
install.promptBody: Add to your home screen for faster reordering and order notifications.
install.installed: Installed — open it from your home screen or desktop
install.howTo: Add it to your home screen — tap to see how
install.alreadyInstalled: Already installed? Your browser will not offer it again — open {name} from your home screen or desktop instead.

steps.iosSafari: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari, then choose Add to Home Screen.
steps.iosOtherBrowser: Tap the Share button, then choose Add to Home Screen. If it is not there, open this page in Safari and do the same.
steps.inAppBrowser: This browser inside another app cannot install apps. Open the menu (⋯ or ⋮), choose Open in browser, then install it from there.
steps.android: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right of your browser, then choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
steps.desktopChromium: Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar, or open the ⋮ menu and choose Cast, save and share › Install page as app.
steps.desktopSafari: In Safari’s menu bar, choose File › Add to Dock.
steps.desktopFirefox: Firefox on a computer cannot install apps. Open this page in Chrome, Edge or Safari to install it.
steps.unknown: Open your browser’s menu and look for Install app or Add to Home screen.
